cases.message: compute_psf: mft_method= is only meaningful with method='mft' (got method='fft').  It names the route through the matrix Fourier transform ('auto' / 'bluestein' / 'separable' / 'direct'); the FFT sampler takes one centred FFT and reaches no such transform.

propagate(method='asm', mft_method='bluestein'): mft_method= names the route through the matrix Fourier transform and only the MFT output-grid legs reach one -- method in ('asm', 'fresnel', 'fraunhofer') WITH output_grid= or output_dx=.  This call reaches no MFT transform, so the keyword would be dropped.  Drop it, or ask for an output grid.

propagate(method='rs', output_grid/output_dx=...): Rayleigh-Sommerfeld does not support arbitrary output-grid sampling in 4.12 (no MFT variant).  Use method='asm' (auto-promotes to angular_spectrum_propagate_mft) for output-pitch sampling.

propagate_carrier_referenced: mft_method= names the route through the matrix Fourier transform, which only the Collins transport evaluates; transport='sziklas' is the Sziklas-Siegman scaled-coordinate Fresnel transform and reaches no such primitive.  Drop the keyword, or pass transport='collins'.
